$comment: Each upstream .github/workflows file and where the fork runs it. upstream-merge reports changed or unlisted workflows against this map. disposition: pipeline | github-only | later.

ci.yml.notes: Rust tests, the xvfb desktop launch smoke and mobile_native_static_analysis are not ported in ci. release compiles Rust helpers from source; native mobile analysis needs macOS.

agent-context-budget.yml.notes: ci job context-budget; --allow-context-increase stands in for the label

mobile-fingerprint-check.yml.notes: needs the mobile toolchain on this host

mobile-dev-client.yml.notes: Android needs Java and Gradle; iOS needs macOS

release.yml.notes: Manual draft/plan/promote for desktop and CLI only. npm t3, Vercel web, marketing, AUR, Discord, mobile and nightly feed pointers remain upstream-only.

release-desktop.yml.notes: Linux x64 AppImage/deb, cross-built Windows x64 NSIS with native payload check, ssh moonborn macOS arm64 DMG/zip and matching CLI archives. All unsigned; optional Apple signing hooks. Linux/Windows arm64 and macOS x64 are omitted.

thread-transfer-report.yml.notes: PR comment; its node --test self-test runs in ci test (release-checks)
